title: Home, Small as a Thumb
text: The relay keeps forwarding. The seam keeps its secret. From the mast's rim Home is a blue crescent, small enough to cover with a thumb. Three new routes are on the Gantry's card: Verdance, where Marrow's voice comes from; Talus, a rock with room for a yard; and Ash, where one of the relay's carriers points.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Behind it the mast goes on forwarding, as if nobody had called.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay by the mast a while, listening to it forward our report.

notes: onDone of first-light. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
